method.delta_lnb: lnZ(full) - lnZ(without X), from final MultiNest stats.dat; matched only by scenario/time/dataset/seed
method.numeric_error: quadrature of the two MultiNest lnZ errors, assuming independent numerical errors
method.sellke_sigma: signed inversion of the Sellke upper-bound relation; descriptive upper bound, not frequentist detection significance
